subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared inbound attachment metadata contract for agents, or keep Slack attachments represented only as placeholders plus media path/type fields for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes the agent-facing channel/plugin context shape and should not be chosen by automation as a Slack-only one-off.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel InboundAttachments-style field while preserving existing MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Document that Slack file IDs are exposed through placeholders and downloadable media references, and defer structured metadata.

options.title: Prototype Slack-Only Metadata
options.body: Add narrow Slack metadata first, accepting later migration risk if Discord and Telegram need a different shared shape.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel InboundAttachments-style field while preserving existing MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Slack media behavior and shared inbound media contracts, both connected to this person's recent history and issue discussion mention.
